metadata.question: Was there more green vegetation visible around Onemen Bay near Anadyr on August 9, 2025, than on September 11, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- AOI: Polygon around Onemen Bay near Anadyr, Russia (approx 64.57–64.95N, 177.05–178.00E).
- Dates: target windows ±4 days around 2025-08-09 and 2025-09-11. If empty, widen to ±11 days.
- Collections: Try COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED first; fallback to COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED (L1C); then fallback to merged LANDSAT 8/9 L2 SR.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds/shadows/snow using S2 SCL or QA60; Landsat QA_PIXEL bits.
- Compute NDVI and count “green vegetation” as NDVI ≥ 0.3.
- Compute valid pixel counts and green fractions at 1000 m scale to avoid timeouts.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- C1 if no images after recovery for either period.
- C2 if images exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either period.
- C3 if any reduceRegion returns null/NaN.
- Otherwise compare green fraction between the two periods; strictly greater -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
}

function s2srMaskNdvi(img) {
  // S2 SR: use SCL to mask clouds/shadows/snow + NDVI from B8/B4
  var scl = img.select('SCL');
  var mask = scl.neq(3) // cloud shadow
    .and(scl.neq(8))    // medium probability cloud
    .and(scl.neq(9))    // high probability cloud
    .and(scl.neq(10))   // thin cirrus
    .and(scl.neq(11));  // snow
  var ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
  return ndvi.updateMask(mask);
}

function s2l1cMaskNdvi(img) {
  // S2 L1C: mask using QA60 bits 10 & 11 (clouds, cirrus)
  var qa = img.select('QA60');
  var cloudBit = 1 << 10;
  var cirrusBit = 1 << 11;
  var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0));
  var ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
  return ndvi.updateMask(mask);
}

function landsatL2MaskNdvi(img) {
  // Landsat 8/9 L2: mask clouds, cloud shadow, cirrus, snow; scale reflectance
  var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
  var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)  // dilated cloud
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))     // cloud
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // cloud shadow
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));    // snow
  var scale = 0.0000275;
  var offset = -0.2;
  var red = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(scale).add(offset);
  var nir = img.select('SR_B5').multiply(scale).add(offset);
  var ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI');
  return ndvi.updateMask(mask);
}

async function getBestCollectionAndNDVI(geom, startDate, endDate) {
  // Try primary window first; if empty across providers, widen window
  const attempts = [
    {start: startDate, end: endDate, note: ''},
    {start: ee.Date(startDate).advance(-7, 'day'), end: ee.Date(endDate).advance(7, 'day'), note: ' (widened)'}
  ];

  for (const att of attempts) {
    // Try Sentinel-2 SR
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(att.start, att.end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size > 0) {
      return {
        provider: 'S2_SR' + att.note,
        size: size,
        ndviComp: col.map(s2srMaskNdvi).median().rename('NDVI')
      };
    }

    // Try Sentinel-2 L1C
    col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(att.start, att.end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size > 0) {
      return {
        provider: 'S2_L1C' + att.note,
        size: size,
        ndviComp: col.map(s2l1cMaskNdvi).median().rename('NDVI')
      };
    }

    // Try Landsat 8/9 L2 merged
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(att.start, att.end);
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(att.start, att.end);
    col = l8.merge(l9);
    size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size > 0) {
      return {
        provider: 'Landsat8/9_L2' + att.note,
        size: size,
        ndviComp: col.map(landsatL2MaskNdvi).median().rename('NDVI')
      };
    }
  }

  return {provider: null, size: 0, ndviComp: null};
}

async function computeStats(label, geom, startDate, endDate) {
  const best = await getBestCollectionAndNDVI(geom, startDate, endDate);
  if (!best.provider) {
    return {error: 'C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).'};
  }

  const ndvi = best.ndviComp;

  // Counts at 1000 m scale
  const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
  }).get('one');

  const validCount = ndvi.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
  }).get('NDVI');

  const meanNdvi = ndvi.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
  }).get('NDVI');

  // Green vegetation mask NDVI >= 0.3
  const greenCount = ndvi.gte(0.3).rename('g').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
  }).get('g');

  const [t, v, g, m] = await Promise.all([
    getInfoAsync(ee.Number(totalCount)),
    getInfoAsync(ee.Number(validCount)),
    getInfoAsync(ee.Number(greenCount)),
    getInfoAsync(ee.Number(meanNdvi))
  ]);

  // Handle C2/C3
  if (t === null || v === null || g === null || m === null || !isFinite(t) || !isFinite(v) || !isFinite(g) || !isFinite(m)) {
    return {error: 'C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN/invalid).'};
  }
  if (v === 0) {
    return {error: 'C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).'};
  }

  const validFrac = v / t;
  const greenFrac = g / v;

  console.log(`${label} Provider=${best.provider}, Images=${best.size}, ValidPx=${v}/${t} (${(validFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%), GreenPx=${g} (${(greenFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%), NDVI(mean)=${m.toFixed(3)}`);

  return {
    provider: best.provider,
    images: best.size,
    total: t,
    valid: v,
    green: g,
    meanNdvi: m,
    greenFrac: greenFrac
  };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[177.05, 64.57],
      [178.00, 64.57],
      [178.00, 64.95],
      [177.05, 64.95],
      [177.05, 64.57]]], null, false);

  const augStart = ee.Date('2025-08-05');
  const augEnd   = ee.Date('2025-08-13');
  const sepStart = ee.Date('2025-09-07');
  const sepEnd   = ee.Date('2025-09-15');

  try {
    const aug = await computeStats('Aug09 2025', geom, augStart, augEnd);
    if (aug.error) {
      console.log(aug.error);
      console.log('C' + aug.error[1] + ': ' + aug.error.split(': ').slice(1).join(': ')); // standardized final tag line
      return;
    }
    const sep = await computeStats('Sep11 2025', geom, sepStart, sepEnd);
    if (sep.error) {
      console.log(sep.error);
      console.log('C' + sep.error[1] + ': ' + sep.error.split(': ').slice(1).join(': '));
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    // Strict comparison: "more green" -> higher green fraction
    const answer = (aug.greenFrac > sep.greenFrac) ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('Processing error:', e && e.message ? e.message : String(e));
    console.log('D: Method/Error (unexpected runtime or API issue).');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
